[[Spaceport Speeders]] buys, trades and sells floater. [[Wioslea]] is known as a shrewd bargainer. [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Luke]] got 2,000 credits for his X-34 speeder.

Sell one of your vehicles or droids at Mos Eisley or same site as [[Wioslea]]. Draw two destiny (three destiny if vehicle is [[Luke's X-34 Landspeeder]]). The total is the 'offer,' which you must accept. Activate that much Force; then vehicle or droid is lost.

[[Spaceport Speeders]] is one of those interrupts which definately doesn't fit in every deck, but on the other hand it can offer an opportunity to make one of those 'wow look at the expression on my opponents face' surprise force activations. And in a high destiny deck this averages around 10-12 force per use.

If used in numbers it also can speed up your deck considerably. A few R2X2's deployed for 1 force on your first turn at Mos Eisely and then two [[Spaceport Speeders]] means big deployment on your first turn.

Also the fact that it is used and has 6 destiny means that it's matches the high destiny theme. :)

Negative side: You need to be playing Mos Eisely (what game DOESN'T usually have it in play?) or [[Wioslea]], and have vehicles or droids there. It also means that the droids and vehicles you're losing must be 'throwaways'. The best way I can see getting around this is to stack your deck with mining droids, which also are good forfeit-meat.

Best Combo: [[Spaceport Speeders]] and It could be worse. You can avoid MASSIVE amounts of damage this way. Or, use a CZ3 or some other react ability to surprise your opponent with a mittful of rebel troopers, or weapons they think you can't use.
